RQ01.sql: SELECT productid, name, listprice, standardcost FROM production.product WHERE name = 'Touring-1000 Yellow, 54'

RQ02.sql: SELECT p.productid, i.locationid, i.shelf, i.bin, i.quantity FROM production.product p JOIN production.productinventory i ON i.productid = p.productid WHERE p.name = 'HL Mountain Frame - Black, 38' ORDER BY i.locationid, i.shelf, i.bin

RQ03.sql: SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) AS active_supplier_count FROM purchasing.vendor WHERE activeflag = true

RQ04.sql: SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) AS purchased_product_count FROM production.product WHERE makeflag = false

RQ05.sql: SELECT productid, name, sellenddate FROM production.product WHERE sellenddate IS NULL ORDER BY productid LIMIT 10

RQ06.sql: SELECT productid, name, productnumber, color, size FROM production.product WHERE name = 'Touring-1000 Yellow, 54'

RQ07.sql: SELECT pc.productcategoryid, pg_catalog.count(p.productid) AS product_count FROM production.productcategory pc JOIN production.productsubcategory ps ON ps.productcategoryid = pc.productcategoryid JOIN production.product p ON p.productsubcategoryid = ps.productsubcategoryid WHERE pc.name = 'Components' GROUP BY pc.productcategoryid

RQ08.sql: SELECT p.productid, p.safetystocklevel, COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(i.quantity), 0) AS actual_stock, GREATEST(p.safetystocklevel - COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(i.quantity), 0), 0) AS shortage FROM production.product p LEFT JOIN production.productinventory i ON i.productid = p.productid WHERE p.name = 'Paint - Black' GROUP BY p.productid, p.safetystocklevel

RQ09.sql: SELECT p.productid, pg_catalog.sum(d.orderqty) AS sales_volume FROM production.product p JOIN sales.salesorderdetail d ON d.productid = p.productid WHERE p.finishedgoodsflag = true GROUP BY p.productid ORDER BY sales_volume DESC, p.productid LIMIT 5

RQ10.sql: SELECT h.vendorid, pg_catalog.sum(d.rejectedqty) AS rejected_quantity FROM purchasing.purchaseorderheader h JOIN purchasing.purchaseorderdetail d ON d.purchaseorderid = h.purchaseorderid GROUP BY h.vendorid HAVING pg_catalog.sum(d.rejectedqty) > 0 ORDER BY rejected_quantity DESC, h.vendorid LIMIT 5

RQ11.sql: SELECT w.workorderid, w.productid, w.scrappedqty, w.scrapreasonid FROM production.workorder w WHERE w.scrappedqty > 0 ORDER BY w.scrappedqty DESC, w.workorderid LIMIT 5

RQ12.cypher: MATCH path=(component:Product {name: 'Paint - Black'})<-[:REQUIRES_COMPONENT*1..4]-(finished:Product) WHERE finished.sellableFinishedGood = true RETURN component.productId, finished.productId, length(path)

RQ13.cypher: MATCH path=(finished:Product {name: 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58'})-[:REQUIRES_COMPONENT*1..4]->(component:Product) RETURN finished.productId, component.productId, length(path)

RQ14.cypher: MATCH (supplier:Supplier {name: 'Allenson Cycles'})-[:SUPPLIES]->(component:Product)<-[:REQUIRES_COMPONENT*1..4]-(finished:Product) WHERE supplier.active = true RETURN supplier.supplierId, component.productId, finished.productId
